My name is Kayla Duncan. I am an Ohio licensed massage therapist and the owner and operator of Northeast Ohio Clinical Massage. I am a peer provider meaning that I myself have medical diagnoses and chronic pain just like my clients do. I know how hard being a pain body is. I also know ways to help manage chronic pain and dysfunction with gentle and advanced neuromuscular treatment techniques. Join me on YouTube, facebook, or in my massage studio located in Warren, Ohio. 

My journey began in 2020 when I first discovered the benefits of self massage. I went to massage school in 2021 and became an LMT in 2022. I recently celebrated one year in the field as a remedial/medical/clinical therapist. Please visit my website for more information about me and my work. I offer both in person and virtual massage therapy sessions. 

https://neoclinicalmassage.amtamembers.com
